name: ask-secret
description: Create a one-time browser handoff link for entering a secret without putting the value in chat.

interface.shortDescription: Request a secret through a one-time link.
interface.longDescription: Ask Secret creates a one-time browser link where a person can enter a password, token, or other secret. The value is never requested, displayed, or echoed in the agent conversation.
defaultPrompt: Create a secure link for entering a secret
